Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 measurements with exact standard relation and non-null pChEMBL values against the human single-protein target CHEMBL1741218. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
